tests.name: Duplicates
Mixed inserts and deletes
tests.setup:
h = MaxHeap()
out = []
for v in [10, 20]:
    h.insert(v)
out.append(h.delete())
for v in [5, 30, 25]:
    h.insert(v)
out += [h.delete() for _ in range(5)]
tests.hint: When trickling down, swap with the bigger of the two children.
